id: title:jurajmajerik:flag empty precompute canary reads instead of skipping them

review.posthog_relevance: Changes the outcome of canary evaluation for funnel experiments, potentially affecting the reliability of experiment results.
review.reason: Replaces the condition for skipping canary evaluation: the code now skips only when ALL runs are empty, whereas before it skipped if ANY run was empty. This could change the outcome of the canary evaluation for funnel experiments.
review.uncertainty: The actual impact on experiment reliability and user benefit is not demonstrated; this is a potential change rather than a verified improvement.

observations.limitations: Only supplied hunk IDs are cited. No score assigned. No adoption, incident, or benefit inferred. No tier assigned.
